Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.

3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES) Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Planning Commission. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the Commission Secretary. If at least two Planning Commissioners agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question. See further instructions below under Procedures for Addressing the Commission.
5.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act (open meetings for local bodies, California Government Code Section 54950 et seq.).
6.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the Commission Secretary. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Commissioner or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar. See further instructions below under Procedures for Addressing the Commission.
